summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native 'Get Fit Faster' app tested across all 4 tabs (Home, Activity, Diet, Profile). All screens render correctly with no red-screen/page errors. All required testIDs (27+) resolve in DOM, all static demo data displays as specified, bottom tab navigation works, and TouchableOpacity taps (settings rows, logout) respond. Fixed one testID propagation bug in GlassCard component which was blocking detection of 10+ card-level testIDs (steps-card, calories-card, water-card, insight-card, summary-card, activity-card-*, totals-card, stats-card, goal-card, settings-list).

react_native_issues.issue: Did not forward testID prop to the underlying View; all GlassCard-wrapped testIDs were absent from the DOM. FIXED by adding testID?: string to Props and spreading to <View testID={testID}>.

action_items: No functional fixes required - app matches spec.

Optional cleanup (non-blocking): React Native Web deprecation warnings logged in console - 'shadow*' style props should migrate to 'boxShadow' (goal-card avatarRing) and 'props.pointerEvents' should move to 'style.pointerEvents'. These are warnings only and do not break the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: GlassCard did not forward testID to its wrapper View (fixed). Consider also forwarding accessibilityLabel/role for better a11y/testing.
All screens correctly use React Native primitives (View/Text/TouchableOpacity/ScrollView/Image) and StyleSheet.create; no raw HTML; all text wrapped in <Text>.

Static data correctly matches spec: Home 6,540 steps / 320 kcal / 2.5L; Activity Running 30m/3km, Walking 45m/4km, Cycling 20m/5km; Diet has 3 meals with calories/protein/carbs/fat macros; Profile shows John Doe, 175cm/70kg/-5kg, Lose 5 kg goal, 6 settings rows + Log Out.
seed_data_creation: None - app is fully static/hardcoded demo data per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App uses expo-router bottom tabs at routes /, /activity, /diet, /profile. Navigate between tabs via visible text labels ('Home','Activity','Diet','Profile'). GlassCard now forwards testID, so all card testIDs resolve. Expo bundler takes ~30-45s to rebuild after a restart, so use page.wait_for_selector with 45s timeout on first load after supervisorctl restart expo.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (GlassCard testID missing): The GlassCard component declared Props without a testID field, so testID props passed by Home/Activity/Diet/Profile screens were silently dropped and never rendered as data-testid in the Expo web output. REPRODUCTION: Before fix, await page.query_selector('[data-testid="steps-card"]') returned null despite the card being visually rendered. MITIGATION: Added `testID?: string` to Props type and applied `testID={testID}` on the outer <View> wrapper. Verified by running full end-to-end Playwright suite: all 27 testIDs now resolve and all tabs/screens/taps pass.
